# Japan Pop Now — Complete Content Index
> Your ultimate guide to Japan's anime and pop culture scene for international visitors.

## About
Japan Pop Now is an English-language media site covering anime collab cafes, pilgrimage spots, area guides, and travel tips for visitors to Japan. Updated April 2026.
